title: Zigzag Level Sum of Binary Tree
summary: Given a binary tree, traverse it level by level in a zigzag pattern.
statement: Given a binary tree, traverse it level by level in a zigzag pattern. At odd levels, traverse left to right; at even levels, right to left. Stop before the first node that lacks a left child at odd levels or a right child at even levels. Sum the node values processed at each level and return these sums in an array.
constraints: Traverse tree levels starting with left-to-right at the root, then alternate direction.
Within a level, stop before the first visited node missing its direction-side child: left child for left-to-right, right child for right-to-left.
Append the sum processed before that stop for every nonempty level.

reference_solution:
def zigzag_level_sums(root):
    if root is None:return []
    level=[root];left=True;answer=[]
    while level:
        total=0
        for node in (level if left else reversed(level)):
            child=node.left if left else node.right
            if child is None:break
            total+=node.val
        answer.append(total);level=[child for node in level for child in (node.left,node.right) if child is not None];left=not left
    return answer
